{{Youmay|the metal|the character [[Phirk]]}}
[[File:Phrik.png|thumb|A phrik sample]]
'''Phrik''' was a metallic compound and one of the few known substances capable of resisting [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. Though often depicted with a gold-like sheen when highly refined, its coloration varied based on processing, treatment, and alloy composition.  It was used in the construction of extremely light and durable battle armor<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'' Gamemaster Guide''</ref> as well as melee weapons. On a more extreme scale, at one point in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a container of phrik was able to stay intact when it was on the surface of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during its destruction.

One major source of phrik was the [[phrikite]] [[Gromas Mines|mines]] of [[Gromas 16]] which would be combined with [[Tydirium (ore)|tydirium]]<ref name="Kyle Katarn's Tale">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/kylekatarnstale3|series=Kyle Katarn's Tale|text=Mission 3}}</ref> to make this compound. Phrik was extremely durable and light, but it was also very expensive and as a result it saw limited use in warfare.

==History==
[[File:Electrostaffs.jpg|250px|thumb|Two types of [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]], made from phrik.]]
The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]], [[Gorman Vandrayk]], devised phrik alloy on his own before the [[Mandalorian Wars]], and may in fact have been its inventor. Millennia before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the extinct [[Fenelar]] used phrik in the creation of their armor.<ref name="Kyle Katarn's Tale" /> It was later used in the pole arms of [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]]' [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]], not only for its lightsaber-resistant properties, but for its ability to disperse electricity. [[Darth Sidious' lightsabers/Legends|Darth Sidious's lightsaber]],<ref name="Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> as well as the armor of the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]],<ref name="dark forces">''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''</ref> were also made of phrik. Phrik, while in its smelting stage, was highly malleable, and could be combined with a number of other ores, alloys, and compounds to imbue the phrik's properties with others.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] recognized the strategic value of phrik and nationalized all phrik mining operations as it became aware of them. However, many small-scale mining facilities remained unknown to the Empire and continued to process the ore for other clients, including local governments, Rebel organizations, and crime syndicates, most notably [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]].<ref name="Lords of the Expanse" />

Should the [[Great Temple/Legends|Rebel Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] ever be discovered, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] created a [[Bail Organa's data holocron|datacron]] containing information on a list of other possible replacement planets. This holocron was left on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] at the time of its destruction. However, the phrik container was so durable that it was able to withstand the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] attack, and was later picked up by Han Solo's [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] in order to find a new base.<ref name="bfrs">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> It was also thought to be used to build [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the days of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
